pass_a_gloss: §18 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Wickedness spreads; angels and daughters; arts of magic.
pass_b_english: And evil, spreading and propagating more and more, ended by reaching the whole human race, so that there remained among them only some rare seed of righteousness. And indeed unlawful unions took place upon the earth; angels having had commerce with the daughters of the children of men, these bore them children who, because of their extraordinary size, were called sons of the earth (giants). ([[sons of God … daughters of men >> Bible:Gen 6:1-4]])

Now the angels made a present to their wives of lessons of malice, for they taught them the virtues of plants and herbs, the use of colors and cosmetics, the discovery of precious substances, magic, hatreds, loves, passions, evil suggestions, the secrets of sorcery, every kind of divination and the idolatry proper to those who hate God: all this, entering into the world, poured out a torrent of evil, and righteousness went on weakening. ([[taught … charms / idolatry traditions >> Bible:1 Enoch 8]] allusive; [[idolatry >> Bible:Rom 1:23-25]])
